_doc: T.D1 — the role → tuple manifest (the committed artifact proof:font-census's clause (e) reads). Each role binds a SELECTOR CONTRACT to the tuple it must resolve live: voice ∈ {display, body, mono} (family axis), computed weight, size bounds, style. The VALUES consume the OD-6 owner token (APPROVED 2026-07-05 "Good.", the P-THEME blessed reference worktree-wf_1e744f4d-2bb-3): Instrument Serif display at its TRUE 400 ≥28px, Plus Jakarta Sans body/chrome, Fira Code confined to code/data. `monoAllowedSelectors` is the T.D4 data-register contract — a Fira-Code leaf must match it or the census reds (mono is DATA, never the UI voice); `monoCeiling` is the declared non-editor mono leaf ceiling (desktop sweep, regression-proof; re-derived 70→90 at the easing TERMINAL batch — T.E6's specimen-tile curve identifiers are DATA (`data-register=code`), measured 81 live + slack. KF-ES-36 (X.KF.W6.k): this sentence used to fix that identifier count at 33; the tree yields 28 (the easing catalogue's non-Custom families, counted at the source of record, `easingGroups.ts`). The count is NOT restated with a new numeral — a figure re-frozen in prose drifts again the next time a family is added, and the ceiling this clause exists to justify (`monoCeiling`) is the consumed value, unaffected either way. FOLD by reference to banked KF-ET-34, EXTENDED with this site; zero re-booking.)

_monoContract: T.D4 (RULED) — Fira Code is the DATA register only: literals + tabular digits. A mono leaf must be (a) real code/kbd/pre content, (b) a tabular numeric readout (`tabular-nums`), (c) an explicit identifier chip marked `data-register="code"` (curve names, CSS keywords, the @mbabb handle, preset names — reviewed exceptions, self-documented at the call-site), or (d) a glass-ui-OWNED data voice consumed as-shipped (the SelectTrigger `fira-code` value default — CSS-keyword values; the MetricBadge telemetry label idiom; the EasingPicker curve-authoring instrument — its section captions + readout literal ship in the vendor's own mono-caption data voice, T.E8). A new demo-authored mono UI label reds the census.
